mapper.select: select id, username, password, display_name, phone, warehouse_id, status, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at from sys_user where username = #{username} limit 1

select u.id, u.username, u.display_name, coalesce(group_concat(distinct r.role_code order by r.id separator ','), '') as role_codes, coalesce(group_concat(distinct r.role_name order by r.id separator ','), '') as role_names, w.warehouse_name, u.status, u.last_login_at from sys_user u left join sys_user_role ur on u.id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on ur.role_id = r.id left join warehouse w on u.warehouse_id = w.id group by u.id, u.username, u.display_name, w.warehouse_name, u.status, u.last_login_at order by u.id asc
